scene: 你刚搬进这栋楼不久，隔壁单元新搬来的年轻邻居几乎每天晚上十一点后都会弹钢琴练琴，琴声隔着薄墙清晰地传进你的卧室，你连续两周睡不好、白天工作精神不济。物业目前没有针对安静时段的规定，邻居似乎也没意识到影响了别人。一边是你对安静休息的基本需求，一边是他人在家自由练琴的习惯，这中间横着邻里相处与私人空间的张力。

options.t: 我会选个白天敲开邻居的门，客气地说明自己夜班后需要休息，请他尽量把练琴挪到傍晚前——邻里之间抬头不见低头见，好好说话比闹僵更解决问题。
options.t_en: I will choose to knock on the neighbor's door during the day, politely explain that I need to rest after the night shift, and ask him to try to move the piano practice to before evening - the neighbors will not look up and down, and talking well will solve the problem more than being stiff.

options.t: 我懒得私下交涉，直接把情况反映给物业，要求他们依据已有的社区公约对深夜噪声进行劝阻甚至处罚，规则摆在那里就该照章执行。
options.t_en: I was too lazy to negotiate privately, directly reflecting the situation to the property, asking them to dissuade or even punish late-night noise according to existing community conventions, and the rules should be implemented according to the regulations there.

options.t: 我算了算，买副好点的隔音耳塞戴上凑合睡，不想为了这点事去跟邻居掰扯、把关系闹僵，忍一忍就过去了。
options.t_en: At my discretion, I bought a pair of better soundproof earplugs and put them on to sleep. I didn't want to break up with my neighbors and stiffen my relationship for this, so I just put up with it and passed.

options.t: 我在业主群里发帖提议大家聊聊这件事，并推动草拟一份「晚间安静时段」的规约，让所有住户共同约定几点后不做扰民的事，用集体约定代替各说各话。
options.t_en: In my post in the owner group, I suggested that everyone talk about this matter and promote the drafting of a "quiet time in the evening" protocol, so that all residents can agree to not do things that disturb people after a few hours, and replace each other with a collective agreement.

scene_en: Not long after you moved into the building, the new young neighbors in the next unit practiced the piano almost every night after 11 o'clock, and the sound of the piano clearly passed through the thin wall into your bedroom, and you did not sleep well for two weeks and worked poorly during the day. The property currently has no rules for quiet hours, and neighbors don't seem to be aware of the impact on others. On the one hand is your basic need for quiet rest, and on the other is the habit of others to practice the piano freely at home, which transverses the tension of the neighborhood and private space.

scene: 楼下的公共花坛原本是大家共有的绿化带，最近几户一楼住户在没打招呼的情况下翻土种上了小葱、番茄和生菜，原本整齐的花草被菜垄取代。其他业主觉得公共空间被私人占用、观感也乱了，种菜的邻居则认为反正空着也是空着、还能吃上新鲜菜。这背后是「公共用地谁说了算」与「实用和美观谁优先」的张力。

options.t: 我觉得公共空间怎么用得大伙一起商量，我会提议召开一次业主大会，让种菜的和不种菜的一起把花坛用途定下来，而不是少数人私自决定。
options.t_en: I think that how the public space is used should be discussed by everyone, and I will propose to hold a landlord meeting to let the use of flower beds be determined together with planting vegetables and non-planting vegetables, rather than being decided by a few people.

options.t: 我主张物业直接介入，按管理规定把菜清掉、恢复成公共绿化——公共地块不该被任何一户长期占为己用，规则得有人执行。
options.t_en: I advocate that the property directly intervene and clean up and restore the vegetables to public greening according to the management regulations - the public land should not be occupied by any household for a long time, and the rules must be implemented by someone.

options.t: 我倒觉得种点菜挺好，既绿化了还实惠，只要不影响通行就没必要上纲上线去管，邻里小事别太较真。
options.t_en: I think that it is very good to order dishes, both green and affordable, as long as it does not affect the passage, there is no need to go online, and the small things in the neighborhood should not be too real.

scene_en: The public flower bed downstairs was originally a green belt shared by everyone. Recently, several households on the first floor turned over the soil and planted shallots, tomatoes and lettuce without saying hello. The original neat flowers and plants were replaced by vegetable ridge. Other owners feel that the public space is occupied by private people and the appearance is confusing, while the neighbors who grow vegetables think that it is empty and they can eat fresh vegetables anyway. Behind this is the tension of "public land who decides" and "practical and beautiful who takes priority".

scene: 小区近两个月连发两起电动车电瓶被盗，物业提议由住户自发组建一支志愿者夜间巡逻队来补人防漏洞。有人觉得邻里互相看顾更安心，也有人担心业余巡逻既不专业又可能盘问、惊扰到访的陌生亲友。这牵涉「安全靠谁保障」与「自由受不受打扰」的平衡。

options.t: 我愿意报名加入巡逻队，晚饭后在楼间转两圈，邻里之间搭把手总比光等着被盗强，自己参与也能更放心。
options.t_en: I am willing to sign up for the patrol. After dinner, I turn around the building twice. The handles between the neighbors are always more reliable than the light waiting to be robbed, and I can be more assured of my own participation.

options.t: 治安该交给专业保安和警方，志愿者既没执法权又容易出岔子，真要防盗不如请正规保安或加巡逻岗。
options.t_en: Security should be handed over to professional security guards and the police. Volunteers have no law enforcement authority and are prone to trouble. If you really want to prevent theft, it is better to ask regular security guards or add patrol posts.

options.t: 与其靠人走来走去，我更相信在出入口和楼道装监控摄像头，既全天候又不会骚扰任何住户，效率高还省人力。
options.t_en: Rather than relying on people to walk around, I believe that installing surveillance cameras at entrances and corridors will not harass any residents 24/7, which is efficient and saves manpower.

options.t: 我反对搞巡逻队，怕一旦有人穿着红袖章就爱盘问外来访客、把正常串门的陌生人当贼防，反而让社区气氛紧张。
options.t_en: I am opposed to patrols. I am afraid that once someone wears a red armband, they will interrogate outsiders and treat strangers who normally cross doors as thieves, which will make the atmosphere in the community tense.

options.t: 我出一笔钱赞助请正规保安巡夜，但自己不掺和巡逻，花钱买专业服务比亲自上阵更适合我。
options.t_en: I paid a sum of money to sponsor a regular security patrol night, but I did not participate in the patrol, and it was more suitable for me to spend money on professional services than to join the battle in person.

scene_en: In the past two months, two electric vehicle batteries have been stolen in the neighborhood. The property proposes that residents voluntarily form a volunteer night patrol to fill in the loopholes. Some people feel that neighbors are more comfortable looking out for each other, while others worry that amateur patrols are both unprofessional and may interrogate and disturb visiting strangers. This involves a balance between “who is safe” and “freedom is not disturbed.”

scene: 隔壁户型开始大装修，电钻和敲墙声从早响到晚，断断续续拖了一个多月还没完，你在家开会、休息都被严重打断。对方是按正常流程报了装修许可的，但工期比预期长，你也拿不准是该忍还是该管。一边是「谁家都可能装修」的体谅，一边是「我的安静权也有边界」的计较。

options.t: 我尽量忍着，毕竟迟早要装完，谁家买房后不搞装修呢，将心比心、不为此伤了邻里和气。
options.t_en: I tried my best to persevere. After all, sooner or later, I had to finish the installation. After buying a house, who wouldn't do the renovation? I was concerned and didn't hurt the neighborhood.

options.t: 我要求他严格按规只在工作日白天的许可时段施工，超出时段就找物业或投诉——装修可以，但不能无底线地影响别人正常生活。
options.t_en: I asked him to work strictly in accordance with the regulations only during the permitted hours during the day on weekdays, and to look for properties or complaints beyond the time period - decoration can be done, but it can not affect the normal life of others without bottom line.

scene_en: The house next door began a major renovation. The electric drill and knocking on the wall sounded from morning to night, intermittently dragging on for more than a month. Your meetings and breaks at home were severely interrupted. The other party reported the decoration permit according to the normal process, but the construction period was longer than expected, and you are not sure whether you should tolerate it or not. On the one hand is the consideration of "anyone can decorate", and on the other hand is the consideration of "my right to quiet also has borders".

scene: 小区业委会拿出一份方案，打算把每月物业费上调两成，用来聘请更专业的保洁团队并增加清扫频次，下周要投票表决。支持者说环境好了人人受益，反对者则觉得钱该先花在保安和设施修缮上。这是一笔「多花点钱换更好公共环境」和「每一分钱都得花在刀刃上」之间的权衡。

options.t: 我投赞成票，楼道干净、垃圾及时清运，住着舒服，环境好是全体住户都享得到的实惠。
options.t_en: I voted for it. The corridors are clean, the garbage is cleared in time, and I live comfortably. The environment is good and affordable for all residents.

options.t: 我反对涨价，认为这笔钱更该投到门禁和夜间安保上，保洁现状勉强够用，优先级得排一排。
options.t_en: I oppose the price increase, and think that this money should be put into access control and night security. The current cleaning status is barely enough, and the priority must be ranked first.

options.t: 我先把账看明白再投票——要求物业把近年收支账本公开，钱花得值不值、有没有虚高，得先说清楚。
options.t_en: I first read the accounts clearly before voting - requiring the property to disclose the income and expenditure accounts of recent years. The money is not worth the money, whether it is expensive or not, we must first clarify.

options.t: 我建议别涨那么多，改成降低保洁频次或缩减范围来省钱，既保基本卫生又不给住户添太多负担。
options.t_en: I suggest not going up so much, but saving money by reducing the frequency or scope of cleaning to ensure basic hygiene without putting too much burden on residents.

scene_en: The district industry committee came up with a plan to increase the monthly property fee by 20% to hire a more professional cleaning team and increase the frequency of cleaning, and vote next week. Supporters say the environment is better for everyone, while opponents feel the money should be spent on security and amenities first. This is a trade-off between “spending more money for a better public environment” and “spending every penny on the blade.”

scene: 社区那间多功能活动室每天傍晚都挤满了人——广场舞队要排练、棋牌组要打牌、亲子读书会也要用，三拨人常为时段争得面红耳赤。场地就一间，谁都想多用，居委会还没拿出稳定的分配办法。这考验的是「先到先得」的效率和「轮流共享」的公平之间怎么选。

options.t: 我主张谁先来订就用谁先用，按报名时间排，简单透明、不偏袒，省得有人为排班吵。
options.t_en: I advocate whoever books first, who uses first, according to the registration time, simple and transparent, unbiased, so that no one can make noise for the schedule.

options.t: 我倾向由居委会统一排班、各团体固定轮换时段，这样每家都能轮上、不会因为「会抢」就一直占着。
options.t_en: I prefer to have a unified schedule by the neighborhood committee and fixed rotation time for each group, so that each family can take their turn and will not occupy it all the time because of "robbing".

options.t: 不如每月抽签决定这间屋的使用权归哪拨人，碰运气最没话说，谁也说不上不公。
options.t_en: It would be better to draw a lottery every month to decide which people have the right to use this room. When you are lucky, you have the least to say, and no one can say unfairly.

options.t: 我建议按付费高低分配，愿意多出维护费的团体优先用，收来的钱正好补贴活动室开销。
options.t_en: I recommend distributing according to the level of payment, groups that are willing to pay more maintenance fees are preferred, and the money received is just enough to subsidize the expenses of the activity room.

options.t: 各团体轮流使用，真撞期了就现场投票少数服从多数，让使用的人自己协商解决。
options.t_en: Each group took turns to use it. During the real collision period, the minority voting on the site was obeyed by the majority, and the users were allowed to negotiate and solve it themselves.

options.t: 改成线上预约制，超额申请的部分摇号决定，谁都能约、碰上了靠运气，规则清楚不用人管。
options.t_en: Changing to the online reservation system, the excessive application part of the decision, anyone can make an appointment, met the luck, the rules are clear without people.

scene_en: The multi-purpose activity room in the community is full of people every evening - the square dance team needs to rehearse, the chess team needs to play cards, and the parent-child reading meeting needs to be used. The three groups often compete for time and ears. The venue is just one room, everyone wants to use more, and the neighborhood committee has not yet come up with a stable allocation method. This tests the choice between first-come, first-served efficiency and fairness in sharing by turns.

scene: 小区里几只流浪猫接连生了崽，数量越来越多，爱猫的住户天天在固定角落投喂，怕猫的住户则抱怨异味、叫声和翻垃圾。要不要干预、怎么干预，大家在业主群里吵了很久没结论。这关乎动物的生存处境，也关乎人居环境的舒适与不同住户的意愿。

options.t: 我加入 TNR 行动，联系志愿者把猫抓去绝育再放回来，并在群里发起募捐分担费用，既控制数量也不伤害它们。
options.t_en: I joined the TNR operation, contacted volunteers to catch the cats and sterilize them before releasing them back, and launched a fundraiser in the group to share the cost, neither controlling the number nor hurting them.

options.t: 我认为该请专业机构把猫群整体捕捉、安置或送养，零散投喂治标不治本，得有统一管理才稳妥。
options.t_en: I think that it is necessary to ask professional institutions to capture, place or send cats to adoption as a whole, and give them scattered feeding to treat the symptoms without curing the root cause, and it must have unified management before it is safe.

options.t: 我选择不插手，猫有猫的活法，生态自会调节，人为干预反而打破平衡，随它去吧。
options.t_en: I choose not to interfere. Cats have their own way of living, and the ecology will adjust itself. Human intervention will break the balance. Let it go.

scene_en: Several stray cats in the community have babies in succession, and the number is increasing. Householders who love cats are feeding in fixed corners every day. Householders who are afraid of cats complain about odors, cries, and garbage. Whether to intervene or not, how to intervene, everyone has been arguing in the owner group for a long time without a conclusion. This is related to the survival situation of the animals, as well as the comfort of the living environment and the willingness of different residents.

scene: 楼上住户水管老化爆裂，水渗下来把你家客厅天花板泡了一大片，墙皮脱落、灯具也进了水，对方态度还不错但反复说「谁家没点意外」。修要花钱，责任界线和分摊比例却说不清。这是典型的邻里财产纠纷——是各退一步，还是按责索赔。

options.t: 我自认倒霉，找人把天花板补了、灯修好，懒得为这点钱跟邻居翻脸，远亲不如近邻。
options.t_en: I considered myself unlucky. I found someone to repair the ceiling and repair the lights. I was too lazy to turn my face with the neighbors for a little money. Far relatives are not as good as neighbors.

options.t: 我要求楼上承担全部维修和材料费，是他家管道的问题淹了我家的房，该赔就得赔。
options.t_en: I asked the upstairs to bear the full cost of maintenance and materials. It was the problem of his plumbing that flooded my house, and the compensation would have to be paid.

options.t: 我提议两家各出一半维修费，邻里嘛和为贵，闹太僵以后抬头不见低头见都尴尬。
options.t_en: I propose that each of the two families pay half of the maintenance fee. The neighborhood is very expensive. It is embarrassing to look up without looking down after it is too stiff.

options.t: 我不跟邻居私下扯皮，直接请物业来查原因、定责任比例，按第三方说法办，避免人情绑架。
options.t_en: I do not talk to my neighbors privately. I directly ask the property to find out the cause and determine the proportion of responsibility. I will follow the third party's instructions to avoid humane kidnapping.

scene_en: The water pipes of the residents upstairs were aging and burst. The water seeped down and soaked a large area of the ceiling of your living room. The wall skin fell off and the lamps and lanterns also entered the water. The other party had a good attitude, but repeatedly said, "Who's home is not an accident?" It cost money to repair, but the boundaries of responsibility and the proportion of apportionment were unclear. This is a typical neighborhood property dispute - a step back or a liability claim.

scene: 社区里不少独居老人做饭困难、吃饭凑合，热心居民想在小区空置用房办一个平价邻里食堂，专门照顾老人用餐。有人愿意出钱出力，也有人担心食品安全责任和油烟扰民。这涉及互助温情与「办在自家楼下」带来的实际顾虑。

options.t: 我捐一笔钱并报名当义工，帮老人打饭、收拾，邻里互相照应本来就是社区该有的样子。
options.t_en: I donated a sum of money and signed up as a volunteer to help the elderly eat and clean up, and the neighborhood took care of each other as it should have been in the community.

options.t: 这种民生好事该由街道或物业出钱办、统一管护，靠居民零散凑钱难长久，也该有公家兜底。
options.t_en: Such people's livelihood good deeds should be financed and unifiedly managed by streets or properties. It is difficult to rely on residents to scrape together money for a long time, and there should be public support.

options.t: 我倾向市场化运作，愿意吃的自费购买，由专业餐饮来做，不靠补贴也能转起来。
options.t_en: I prefer to operate in a market-oriented manner. I am willing to buy food at my own expense. It is made by professional catering, and I can turn it around without subsidies.

options.t: 我担心设在小区里万一出食物中毒谁负责、油烟噪音也烦，反对在住宅楼里办食堂。
options.t_en: I am worried about who is responsible for food poisoning in the community, and I am also annoyed by the smoke and noise, and I am opposed to running a canteen in a residential building.

options.t: 我顾好自己家就行，既不捐钱也不反对，别人爱办办、我不掺和。
options.t_en: I just take care of my own family, I don't donate money or object, others love to do it, I don't get involved.

scene_en: Many elderly people living alone in the community have difficulty cooking and eating together. Enthusiastic residents want to run an affordable neighborhood cafeteria in an empty house in the community to specialize in taking care of the elderly. Some are willing to pay for it, while others worry about food safety responsibilities and fumes. This involves the warmth of mutual help and the practical concerns brought about by "doing it downstairs in your own home".

scene: 隔壁邻居把旧纸箱、童车和几袋杂物长期堆在楼道里，原本就不宽的通道更挤了，你推婴儿车出门总得侧身绕。对方说「放自己门口又不碍谁」，你却觉得这是消防和通行的公共区域。这关乎私人便利和公共通道安全的拉扯。

options.t: 我当面跟他说清楚，楼道堆物挡了路也堵了消防，请他把东西收回屋里，邻里直说比背后投诉强。
options.t_en: I made it clear to him in person that the pile of corridors blocked the road and blocked the firefighting. I asked him to return the things to the house. The neighborhood was better than the complaints behind it.

options.t: 我懒得跟他起正面冲突，直接找物业来处理、让物业去清，省得伤了面子以后见面尴尬。
options.t_en: I was too lazy to start a face-to-face conflict with him. I directly found the property to deal with and let the property go to clean up, so that I could not be embarrassed to meet after I had hurt my face.

scene_en: The neighbors next door have piled up old cartons, strollers, and bags of debris in the corridor for a long time. The passage that was originally not wide is more crowded, and you have to walk around the stroller. The other person says, "It's okay to leave it at your doorstep," but you feel that this is a common area for firefighting and traffic. It's about the tug of war between private convenience and the safety of public access.

scene: 项目临上线出了状况，公司临时要求全组周末无偿加班赶工，明说不给调休也不给加班费，主管在群里@所有人「要有大局观」。你算了一下，这已经是两个月里第三次了。一边是项目集体利益，一边是自己被无偿占用的休息权和劳动回报。

options.t: 我服从安排留下来加班，项目紧的时候集体利益要紧，团队扛过去比个人的周末更重要。
options.t_en: I obey the arrangement to stay and work overtime, when the project is tight, the collective interest is important, and the team is more important than the personal weekend.

options.t: 我要求公司依法支付加班费，给不出合理报酬我就拒绝无偿加班——我的休息时间和劳动不是白给的。
options.t_en: I ask the company to pay overtime according to law, and I refuse to work unpaid overtime without a reasonable remuneration - my rest time and labor are not given for free.

options.t: 我嘴上不说什么，私下开始更新简历、悄悄看外面的机会，这种一直白嫖加班的公司待不久。
options.t_en: I didn't say anything, began to update my resume privately, and quietly looked at the opportunities outside, this company that had been working overtime for a long time.

scene_en: The situation occurred when the project was on-line. The company temporarily required the entire group to work unpaid overtime on the weekends. It was clearly stated that no vacation or overtime pay would be given. The supervisor in the group @ Everyone "must have a big picture". You calculate, this is the third time in two months. On the one hand is the collective interest of the project, and on the other hand is the right to rest and the return of labor that is occupied without compensation.

scene: 部门要砍掉三分之一的人，主管把名单建议权交给你，让你提该留谁走谁。留下的人都认识、要走的也可能是并肩几年的同事，你怎么排都伤人。这考验的是「凭什么决定别人的去留」——资历、能力、家庭还是运气。

options.t: 我建议按入职资历排，先走新人、留住老员工，团队稳定和经验延续更重要。
options.t_en: I suggest that according to the seniority of entry, it is more important to go new people first, retain old employees, and maintain team stability and experience.

options.t: 我主张唯才是举，谁产出高、谁不可替代就留谁，感情和资历不该凌驾于事效。
options.t_en: I advocate that meritocracy is a move, whoever produces high output and whoever is irreplaceable should be left behind, and feelings and qualifications should not override effectiveness.

options.t: 我建议优先保住家里唯一经济来源的那位，失业对他家是灭顶之灾，人情味得有。
options.t_en: I suggest giving priority to the one who keeps the only source of income in the family. Unemployment is a disaster for his family, and it has a human touch.

options.t: 我说干脆抽签定去留，谁走谁留全看运气，这样最没争议、不显得针对谁。
options.t_en: I said that I would simply draw lots to stay, and who would leave it all to luck, so it was the least controversial and did not seem to be aimed at anyone.

scene_en: The department wants to cut one-third of the people, and the supervisor gives you the right to suggest the list and let you know who should be left behind. The people who are left behind all know and want to leave may also be colleagues who have been working side by side for several years. How can you hurt everyone in the row? The test is “why do you decide to stay” - seniority, ability, family, or luck.

scene: 同组一个同事总把自己的活甩给你，借口「你比较熟」「顺手帮个忙」，你手上的事已经排满了，对方却越来越理所当然。你不接怕关系僵，接了又把自己累垮。这是边界感和好人成本之间的拉扯。

options.t: 我当面和他对清分工，明确哪些是我的、哪些该他自己做，该拒的额外任务我直接说不做。
options.t_en: I cleared the division of labor with him in person, clarifying what was mine and what he should do himself, and I directly said no to the additional tasks that should be refused.

options.t: 我忍着没撕破脸，怕闹起来以后合作更难堪，自己多扛一点、默默吃亏算了。
options.t_en: I endured not to tear my face, fearing that it would be more embarrassing to cooperate after the commotion, and I carried a little more and quietly ate the loss.

scene_en: A colleague in the same group always throws his work to you. On the pretext of "you are familiar" and "help me out", the things you have on your hands are already full, but the other party is getting more and more natural. You don't have to be afraid of relationship stiffness, and then you wear yourself out. It's a tug of war between a sense of boundaries and the cost of good people.

scene: 公司准备上一套排班算法，声称能根据客流自动排班、省掉主管的人工排班时间，并说能「更公平」。但一线员工听说后有人担心系统不近人情、把人当零件排，也有人觉得终于不用看主管脸色。这关乎效率、人情和谁来决定规则。

options.t: 我支持上算法，排班快、不偏心、还省人力成本，比人工拍脑袋强。
options.t_en: I support the algorithm. The scheduling is fast, unbiased, and saves labor costs, which is better than manual headshots.

options.t: 我担心算法冷冰冰不近人情，产假、生理期、家庭突发都不懂变通，应该保留人工调整的余地。
options.t_en: I am worried that the algorithm is cold and impersonal. Maternity leave, menstrual period, and family emergencies are not flexible, and there should be room for manual adjustment.

options.t: 我要求排班规则制定时得有员工代表参与讨论，不能让技术部门关起门来定我们的班。
options.t_en: I ask that the scheduling rules be developed with the participation of staff representatives, and that the technical department not be allowed to close the door and schedule our shift.

options.t: 我无所谓，排班本来就是管理层的事，系统排还是人排都跟我没啥关系。
options.t_en: I don't care. Scheduling is originally a management matter, and neither the system nor the platoon has anything to do with me.

options.t: 我要求公司把算法的逻辑公开、可解释，不能是个黑箱，凭什么排我夜班得让我知道依据。
options.t_en: I asked the company to make the logic of the algorithm public and explainable. It can't be a black box. Why do I have to work night shifts to let me know the basis.

scene_en: The company prepares a scheduling algorithm that claims to automatically schedule according to passenger flow, saves supervisors' manual scheduling time, and says it can be “fairer”. However, after the front-line employees heard that the system was not humane and used people as parts rows, some people felt that they finally did not need to look at the supervisor's face. It's about efficiency, people and who decides the rules.

scene: 一次偶然对账，你发现自己和同岗位、同年限的男同事薪资差了约两成，能力产出其实不相上下。你心里不是滋味，但也不确定该闹还是该忍。这关乎同工同酬、个人谈判和会不会被穿小鞋。

options.t: 我去找 HR 要个说法，要求把同岗薪酬拉平，同样的活不该因为是女性就少拿。
options.t_en: I went to HR to make a statement, asking for equal pay for the same job, and I should not take less because I am a woman.

options.t: 我不去扯性别，靠自己谈下一份涨薪，把业绩摆出来让老板给我加，本事到哪都吃得开。
options.t_en: I don't talk about gender, talk about the next salary increase on my own, put the performance out for the boss to add to me, and I can eat anywhere.

options.t: 我忍了，怕一旦闹起来被边缘化、好项目不再分给我，哑巴亏先吃着。
options.t_en: I put up with it, afraid that once the commotion was marginalized, good projects would no longer be assigned to me, and the mute would eat first.

options.t: 我联合同岗同事一起推动公司公开薪酬区间，让同岗同酬有制度保障，单打独斗太弱。
options.t_en: Together with my colleagues, I have promoted the company to open the salary range, so that the same pay for the same job is guaranteed by the system, and fighting alone is too weak.

scene_en: In a casual reconciliation, you find that you and your male colleagues in the same position and the same year have a salary difference of about 20%, and the ability output is actually comparable. You don't have a taste in your heart, but you're not sure whether to make a fuss or to put up with it. This is about equal pay for equal work, personal bargaining, and whether you will be wearing small shoes.

scene: 经济下行，公司把新人培训预算砍掉大半，主管问你这个老员工怎么看、有没有省钱的替代办法。有人想保住核心成长投入，也有人觉得公司花钱得讲回报。这是「员工成长」和「成本约束」之间的取舍。

options.t: 我建议转成内部老带新，让老人带新人、零成本也能传经验，预算砍了但培养不能断。
options.t_en: I suggest turning into an internal old belt, so that the elderly can bring new people and zero cost can also pass on experience. The budget has been cut, but the training can not be interrupted.

options.t: 我坚持保留核心的那块培训，这是对公司人才的投资，砍了以后新人上手慢、损失更大。
options.t_en: I insist on retaining the core training, which is an investment in the company's talents. After cutting, newcomers will start slowly and lose more money.

options.t: 我主张公司再难也得保障员工成长投入，培训不是可选项，是雇主该负的责任。
options.t_en: I advocate that the company can no longer guarantee the investment in employee growth. Training is not optional, it is the responsibility of the employer.

scene_en: The economy is down, and the company has cut most of the new employee training budget. The supervisor asks you what you think of the old employee and whether there are alternative ways to save money. Some people want to keep their core growth investment, and others feel that the company has to pay for it. This is a trade-off between “employee growth” and “cost constraints.”

scene: 行业里多家公司都在传要降福利，几个同事私下聊起要不要在本公司组建工会、集体跟老板谈待遇。有人想牵头，有人只想搭车，也有人信奉个人单打独斗。这关乎集体议价和个人博弈。

options.t: 我牵头把工会组起来，大家拧成一股绳跟资方谈福利，单个人太好拿捏。
options.t_en: I took the lead in forming the union, and everyone twisted into a rope to talk about welfare with the management. It was too easy to handle it individually.

options.t: 我愿意参加、跟着大家一起谈，但出头牵头的事我就不干了，风险留给别人。
options.t_en: I am willing to participate and talk with everyone, but I will stop taking the lead and leave the risk to others.

options.t: 我反对搞工会，福利该靠自己本事跟老板一对一谈，抱团反而伤了和公司的关系。
options.t_en: I am against trade unions, welfare should rely on their own ability to talk to the boss one-on-one, holding the group but hurt the relationship with the company.

options.t: 我有点担心被公司盯上、穿小鞋，先观望观望再说，不急着站队。
options.t_en: I am a little worried about being targeted by the company and wearing small shoes. I will wait and see before I speak, and I am not in a hurry to stand on the team.

options.t: 我更愿意直接给管理层写建议、走内部沟通改善待遇，不想走对抗那一套。
options.t_en: I prefer to write suggestions directly to the management, take internal communication to improve the treatment, and do not want to go against that set.

options.t: 我无所谓，大家怎么定我就怎么跟，谁牵头都行、不牵头也行。
options.t_en: I don't care. I'll follow whatever you decide. Whoever takes the lead can take it or not.

scene_en: Many companies in the industry are calling for benefits to be reduced, and several colleagues have privately talked about whether to form a union in the company and collectively discuss the treatment with the boss. Some people want to take the lead, some just want a ride, and some people believe that individuals fight alone. It's about collective bargaining and individual gaming.

scene: 季度检查临近，老板暗示你把报表里不好看的数字「美化」一下、圆上过关。你知道这踩了合规红线，但顶头上司亲自开口、拒绝怕被穿小鞋。这是诚信、合规和服从上级之间的两难。

options.t: 我拒绝照做，并跟老板把造假的法律和声誉风险说清楚，不能为了过关埋雷。
options.t_en: I refused to do so, and explained to my boss the legal and reputational risks of counterfeiting, and I could not bury the mine in order to pass the customs.

options.t: 我听上级的，按他意思把数据调漂亮交上去，上面要的我就给、别自作主张。
options.t_en: I listened to my superiors and handed over the data beautifully according to his wishes. If I want it above, I will give it to you, don't make up your own mind.

options.t: 我匿名把情况反映到合规或审计部门，既不正面撕破脸、也把问题捅出去。
options.t_en: I anonymously report the situation to the compliance or audit department, neither tearing my face nor poking the problem out.

options.t: 我提个折中办法，用含糊的口径把数据包装过去，既交了差又没明着造假，糊弄一下算了。
options.t_en: I proposed a compromise method and packaged the data with a vague caliber. I both handed over the bad and did not know how to fake it, so I fooled the calculation.

scene_en: The quarterly inspection is approaching, and the boss suggests that you "beautify" the ugly numbers in the report and pass the circle. You know this is stepping on the compliance red line, but your boss personally opens up and refuses to be afraid of wearing small shoes. This is a dilemma between integrity, compliance, and obedience.

scene: 你入职时签的劳动合同里有一条「在职期间不得从事任何兼职副业」，可你晚上和周末确实想做点自己的小项目赚外快。守约还是把下班时间当自己的，你有点纠结。这关乎契约精神和私人时间归属。

options.t: 我遵守合同，不碰副业，白纸黑字签了就得认，免得违约惹麻烦。
options.t_en: I abide by the contract, do not touch the side business, white paper and black signature must be recognized, so as not to breach the contract and cause trouble.

options.t: 我觉得下班后的时间归我自己，合同管不着八小时之外，悄悄做点副业谁也管不着。
options.t_en: I feel that the time after work belongs to me, the contract can not be controlled for more than eight hours, quietly doing a sideline, no one can care.

scene_en: The labor contract you signed at the time of joining the company has a clause that "you are not allowed to engage in any part-time side job during your tenure", but you do want to do your own small projects at night and on the weekend to make extra money. Keeping the contract or taking the time off work as your own, you are a bit tangled. It's about contractual spirit and private time ownership.

scene: 公司就「以后常态远程办公还是回办公室坐班」征集大家意见，两边各有拥趸——有人嫌通勤累、有人觉得坐班协作顺。你怎么选、要不要公司补贴，各有说法。这是效率、协作和灵活之间的权衡。

options.t: 我倾向远程，省通勤、自己安排节奏反而更高效，在家也能把活干好。
options.t_en: I prefer to work remotely, save on commuting, arrange my own rhythm, but it is more efficient, and I can do a good job at home.

options.t: 我倾向坐班，面对面沟通顺、团队好管，协作氛围是远程比不了的。
options.t_en: I tend to take classes, face-to-face communication is smooth, the team is easy to manage, and the atmosphere of collaboration is incomparable to that of remote work.

options.t: 我主张把这事交给团队自己定，不同组情况不一样，别一刀切。
options.t_en: I advocate leaving this matter to the team to decide for themselves. Different groups are in different situations, so don't be one-size-fits-all.

options.t: 我要求公司补贴我在家办公的网络、水电和工位开销，居家办公也是为公司干活，成本不该全我自己扛。
options.t_en: I ask the company to subsidize the network, utilities and station expenses of my home office. Working from home is also working for the company, and the cost should not be borne by me.

options.t: 我无所谓，公司让怎么来就怎么来，远程坐班都行。
options.t_en: I don't care, the company allows me to come as much as I want, and I can work remotely.

scene_en: The company solicited everyone's opinions on "whether to work remotely or return to the office in the future". There are fans on both sides - some people are tired of commuting, and some people feel that their work is smooth and collaborative. There are different opinions on how to choose and whether to subsidize the company. This is a trade-off between efficiency, collaboration and flexibility.

scene: 一个朋友在微信群里发了个你很反感的玩笑，带点冒犯意味，群里有人附和有人尴尬。你不确定该不该在这种私下小群里较真。这关乎言论边界和朋友面子。

options.t: 我直接在群里说这不好笑，并把为什么让人不舒服讲清楚，冒犯的话不该被笑着带过。
options.t_en: I said directly in the group that it was not funny, and explained clearly why it made people uncomfortable, and offensive words should not be laughed at and brought.

options.t: 我默默把他屏蔽、不再看他的消息，不想为这种事撕破脸、破坏群里气氛。
options.t_en: I silently blocked him and stopped reading his news. I didn't want to tear my face and destroy the atmosphere of the group for this kind of thing.

options.t: 我直接向群主举报，要求把发这种内容的人踢出去，群里的底线得有人守。
options.t_en: I directly reported to the group owner and asked that the person who sent this content be kicked out, and the bottom line in the group must be observed.

scene_en: A friend sent you a very offensive joke in the WeChat group, with a little offensive meaning. Some people in the group were embarrassed. You're not sure if you should be more genuine in this private little group. It's about the boundaries of speech and the face of friends.

scene: 你在公司内网论坛发了篇批评中层管理的帖子，不到半天就被管理员删了，理由是「不符合社区规范」。你觉得自己的意见被捂嘴，又不确定内部平台到底有没有表达空间。这是企业话语权和规则透明之间的张力。

options.t: 我换个匿名渠道继续说，比如小号或外部职场社区，把想讲的问题讲出去。
options.t_en: I switch to an anonymous channel, such as the trumpet or the external workplace community, to talk about the issues I want to talk about.

options.t: 我接受，公司内网本来就是人家地盘，有权管内部言论，不值得为删帖较劲。
options.t_en: I accept that the company's intranet is originally people's territory and has the right to control internal remarks. It is not worth fighting for the deletion of posts.

options.t: 我要求公司把删帖的标准写清楚、公开规则，什么能发什么不能发得有个说法。
options.t_en: I asked the company to clearly write down the criteria for deleting posts, open the rules, and say what can and cannot be sent.

options.t: 我干脆离职，转头在外部公开平台把这家公司的管理问题吐槽一番，用脚投票。
options.t_en: I simply quit my job and turned to an external public platform to talk about the company's management issues and vote with my feet.

scene_en: You made a post in the company intranet forum criticizing the middle management, which was deleted by the administrator within half a day because it was "not in line with community norms". You feel that your opinion is covered, and you are not sure whether there is room for expression on the internal platform. This is the tension between corporate voice and rules transparency.

scene: 你在街上走，有人往你手里塞传单，内容是你完全不认同的观点。对方很热情，你接也不是、不接也不是。这关乎要不要停下来听不同的声音。

options.t: 我接过来翻一翻，听听他们到底在讲什么，不同的观点多了解没坏处。
options.t_en: I took over and flipped over, listening to what they were talking about, there was no harm in knowing more about different perspectives.

options.t: 我绕开走、摆摆手不要，不想被打断行程、也不想被缠上。
options.t_en: I walked around, waved my hand, and didn't want to be interrupted or entangled.

scene_en: You're walking down the street and someone puts a flyer in your hand about something you don't agree with at all. The other person is very enthusiastic, and neither are you answering or not answering. It's about stopping and listening to different voices.

scene: 学校打算请一位观点颇具争议的人士来校做公开演讲，校方内部有分歧——有人怕冲击学生价值观，有人坚持该兼听。要不要请、怎么请，成了讨论焦点。这是学术开放和校园保护之间的张力。

options.t: 应该请，大学就该兼听则明，让学生接触不同甚至刺耳的观点才能学会思辨。
options.t_en: It should be requested that the university should listen to it at the same time, so that students can be exposed to different and even harsh perspectives to learn to think.

options.t: 不该请，他的某些言论可能冲击、误导学生，校园环境需要谨慎把关。
options.t_en: No, some of his remarks may shock and mislead students, and the campus environment needs to be carefully controlled.

options.t: 由学生自己投票决定请不请，受众最有发言权，别由校方少数人替大家定。
options.t_en: It is up to the students themselves to vote on whether to invite or not. The audience has the most say, and it is not up to a few people in the school to decide for everyone.

options.t: 与其单方演讲，不如设成辩论环节，让反方也上台，观点的碰撞比灌输更有价值。
options.t_en: Rather than speaking unilaterally, it is better to set up a debate session and let the opposite party also come to the stage, and the collision of views is more valuable than indoctrination.

options.t: 校方直接审核把关，对演讲内容做合规审查，不合适的一律不批。
options.t_en: The school directly reviews and checks the compliance of the speech content, and does not approve any inappropriate speech content.

scene_en: The school intends to invite a person with controversial views to give a public speech, and there are differences within the school - some are afraid of impacting students' values, and some insist that they should listen. Whether or not to invite, how to invite, became the focus of discussion. This is the tension between academic openness and campus preservation.

scene: 网上一群人正在对你讨厌的一个人发起「人肉搜索」，把他的住址、电话、单位全扒了出来，理由是「他干了坏事活该」。你看着滚动的隐私信息，心里复杂。这关乎以暴制暴和个人隐私底线。

options.t: 我公开谴责这种人肉行为，无论对方做了什么，隐私都不可这样被随意曝光侵犯。
options.t_en: I publicly condemn this kind of human flesh behavior. No matter what the other party does, privacy must not be violated by such arbitrary exposure.

options.t: 我有点理解大家的做法，谁让他先干了伤天害理的事，被人肉也算自找的。
options.t_en: I kind of understand everyone's approach. Whoever let him do the work of hurting the gods first will be counted as self-appointed by human flesh.

options.t: 我直接举报这条人肉帖和相关账号，曝光隐私的行为本身就该被平台处理。
options.t_en: I directly reported this person's post and related account, and the exposure of privacy itself should be handled by the platform.

options.t: 我默默围观、不发言也不转发，看归看、不掺和这趟浑水。
options.t_en: I looked around silently, not speaking or forwarding, looking back and not blending in with this muddy water.

scene_en: A group of people on the Internet are launching a "human flesh search" on a person you hate, pulling out his address, phone number, and work unit, on the grounds that "he did a bad job and deserved it." You look at the scrolling private information, and your mind is complicated. It's about violence and the bottom line of privacy.

scene: 一件当代艺术作品在展览上引发争议，有群体认为它冒犯了自己的身份与信仰，要求下架；创作者和一部分观众则坚称这是艺术表达的自由。场馆方左右为难。这是创作自由与群体感受之间的拉扯。

options.t: 艺术自由优先，不该因为有人不舒服就撤展，表达多元本来就是文化的活力。
options.t_en: Artistic freedom is a priority. It should not be withdrawn because someone is uncomfortable. Expressing diversity is the vitality of culture.

options.t: 应该下架，避免对特定群体的持续伤害，公共展陈得考虑观看者的感受。
options.t_en: Shelves should be removed to avoid sustained harm to specific groups, and public displays should take into account the viewer's feelings.

options.t: 不如加个内容说明标签，把创作背景讲清楚，让观众自己判断是否观看，既不删也不强迫。
options.t_en: It is better to add a content description label, explain the creative background clearly, and let the audience judge for themselves whether to watch, without deleting or forcing.

scene_en: A contemporary artwork caused controversy in the exhibition, and some groups believed that it offended their identity and beliefs, and asked to be removed; the creators and some audiences insisted that it was freedom of artistic expression. The venue is difficult on the left and right. It's a tension between creative freedom and group feeling.

scene: 社区公告栏被人贴出了带攻击性、针对某类住户的标语，路过的人议论纷纷，有人觉得该清、有人觉得这是言论。物业还没表态。这关乎公共空间的表达边界。

options.t: 物业应当立刻把攻击性标语清除，公共区域不该成为攻击特定群体的地方。
options.t_en: Property should remove offensive slogans immediately and common areas should not be a place to target specific groups.

options.t: 应该保留，贴标语也是表达，社区公告栏本就向所有住户开放。
options.t_en: It should be kept, the tagline is also an expression, and the community bulletin board is open to all residents.

options.t: 不该由物业独断，应由居民代表评议后再决定去留，让社区自己定边界。
options.t_en: It should not be left to the property to decide, but should be decided by the resident representative after deliberation, so that the community can determine its own boundaries.

options.t: 我自己在旁边贴一张反驳的标语对冲一下，用更多表达去平衡那一种声音。
options.t_en: I put a rebuttal tagline next to myself to hedge it, and use more expression to balance that kind of voice.

options.t: 我要求双方都把标语撤掉，公告栏保持中性、不站队，才像个公共空间。
options.t_en: I asked both parties to remove the tagline, and the bulletin board remained neutral and did not stand on the team, so as to be like a public space.

options.t: 我懒得管，看到就绕开，这种事操心不动、随它去。
options.t_en: I'm too lazy to care. When I see it, I just go around it. I don't worry about this kind of thing, let it go.

scene_en: Community bulletin boards were posted with aggressive banners targeting certain types of households. Passers-by were arguing. Some people felt that it should be clear and some people felt that it was a speech. The property has not yet made a statement. It's about the boundaries of expression in public spaces.

scene: 你孩子冷不丁问了一个你认为这个年纪还不适合、可能涉及敏感的话题，你一时不知道该如实讲还是先岔开。怎么回关系到坦诚教育和保护童真之间的分寸。

options.t: 我如实、用孩子能懂的方式回答，不回避，觉得该让他早点建立正确认知。
options.t_en: I answered truthfully and in a way that my child could understand. I did not avoid it, and I felt that it was time for him to establish a correct cognition sooner.

options.t: 我先把话题转开，等他再大些、心智更成熟了再聊这个，现在说太早。
options.t_en: I will turn the subject away first, and then talk about this when he is older and his mind is more mature, it is too early to say.

scene_en: Your child coldly asks a topic that you think is inappropriate at this age and may involve sensitive issues, and you don't know whether to tell the truth or diverge first. How to do it is related to the division between honest education and protecting childhood innocence.

scene: 部门会议上，一位同事公开表达了你完全不认同的观点，语气还挺笃定，现场气氛有点微妙。你纠结要不要当场回应。这关乎职场表达和人际关系。

options.t: 我当场提出不同意见、跟他辩论清楚，观点的事就该摊开讲。
options.t_en: I put forward different opinions on the spot, debated clearly with him, and should talk about the point of view.

options.t: 我不当众驳他，会后私下跟他说说我的不同看法，给彼此留面子。
options.t_en: I didn't refute him in public. After the meeting, I told him privately that I had different opinions and left face for each other.

options.t: 我不干涉他表达，他有说的自由，我不认同但不必去堵别人的嘴。
options.t_en: I do not interfere with his expression, he has freedom of speech, I do not agree but do not have to gag others.

options.t: 我向 HR 反映，说这类言论让办公氛围让我不适，希望公司介入引导。
options.t_en: I told HR that this kind of remarks made me uncomfortable with the office atmosphere, and I hoped that the company would step in and guide me.

scene_en: At the department meeting, a colleague publicly expressed your completely disagreement, the tone was quite certain, and the atmosphere on the scene was a little subtle. You struggle to respond on the spot. It's about workplace expression and relationships.

scene: 网上仇恨言论愈演愈烈，有人提议立法加以限制，也有人担心「仇恨」界定模糊会被用来打压异见。是否立法、立到什么程度，社会争论不休。这是遏制伤害与保障表达之间的张力。

options.t: 必须立法，明令禁止针对族群、身份的仇恨言论，弱势群体的尊严得有法律护着。
options.t_en: Legislation must be enacted to explicitly prohibit hate speech against ethnic groups and identities, and the dignity of vulnerable groups must be protected by law.

options.t: 不该立法，仇恨的界线太模糊，一旦入法很容易被权力拿去滥杀异见。
options.t_en: It should not be legislated, the line of hatred is too blurred, and once it enters the law, it is easy to be taken by the power to indiscriminately kill dissent.

options.t: 交给平台自律就好，用社区规则管，不必上升到国家立法层面。
options.t_en: Just leave it to the platform to be self-disciplined and regulated by community rules, without having to rise to the level of national legislation.

options.t: 我只支持限制明确的人身威胁类言论，其余的放开，不能一刀切。
options.t_en: I only support the limitation of explicit personal threats, and the rest should not be left unchecked.

options.t: 我无所谓，立不立法都行，这事离我的日常太远。
options.t_en: I don't care, whether I legislate or not, it's too far from my daily life.

scene_en: Online hate speech is on the rise, with legislation proposed to limit it and concerns that vague definitions of “hate” could be used to silence dissent. Whether or not to legislate and to what extent, the society is constantly debating. This is the tension between deterring injury and securing expression.

scene: 财政吃紧，有关部门拟对高收入群体加税，把多收的部分用于补贴低收入家庭，方案在征求意见。支持者看重缩小差距，反对者担心挫伤投资和创富积极性。这是再分配与激励之间的经典权衡。

options.t: 我支持，收入差距太大不健康，用税收把贫富差距往下拉一拉，社会更稳。
options.t_en: I support that the income gap is too large and unhealthy. Use taxes to pull down the gap between the rich and the poor, and the society will be more stable.

options.t: 我反对，应该降税而不是加税，让资本和创业更有活力、把蛋糕做大。
options.t_en: I oppose that taxes should be reduced rather than raised to make capital and entrepreneurship more vibrant and the cake bigger.

options.t: 我倾向只对奢侈品消费加税，不动辛勤赚来的资产，既调节又不伤根本。
options.t_en: I prefer to raise taxes only on luxury consumption, not on hard-earned assets, neither regulating nor hurting the bottom line.

options.t: 我无所谓，税怎么定我依法交就是，个人改变不了大局。
options.t_en: I don't care. How the tax determines that I pay according to the law is that individuals can't change the overall situation.

scene_en: The financial situation is tight. The relevant departments intend to raise taxes on high-income groups and use the overcharged part to subsidize low-income families. The plan is seeking opinions. Proponents value closing the gap, while opponents worry about discouraging investment and wealth creation. This is the classic trade-off between redistribution and incentives.

scene: 是否设立并定期上调法定最低工资，在政策讨论中争得厉害。劳方说保底尊严，资方说会挤压小微企业和就业。这是保障底线与自由议价之间的拉锯。

options.t: 应该设，并且随物价定期上调，让最底层劳动者也有体面收入。
options.t_en: It should be set up and adjusted regularly with prices, so that the lowest level of workers also have a decent income.

options.t: 不应该设，工资高低该由市场供求决定，强制定价反而害了想就业的人。
options.t_en: It should not be set. The level of wages should be determined by the supply and demand of the market. Mandatory pricing instead harms people who want to work.

options.t: 设是应该的，但要分地区定标准，发达地区和不发达地区不能一个价。
options.t_en: It should be, but to set standards by region, developed and underdeveloped regions cannot be priced at the same price.

scene_en: Whether to establish and regularly increase the statutory minimum wage is a matter of great contention in policy discussions. The labor side said that it would guarantee the dignity of the bottom, and the management said that it would squeeze small and micro enterprises and employment. This is a pull saw between securing the bottom line and free bargaining.

scene: 你意外中了五百万彩票，扣除税后到手一大笔钱，周围人都盯着你打算怎么花。你是想慷慨撒向社会，还是稳妥留给家人，内心自有盘算。这关乎财富观和取舍。

options.t: 我把大部分捐给公益项目和困难群体，自己留够生活就好，钱花在更需要的地方更有意义。
options.t_en: I donate most of my money to charity projects and difficult groups. It makes more sense for me to keep enough for myself and spend it where I need it most.

options.t: 我拿去投资理财，给家人攒下资产、留好退路，辛苦中一次奖得为长远打算。
options.t_en: I used it to invest in financial management, save assets for my family, and leave a good way back. During my hard work, I won a prize for a long-term plan.

scene_en: You accidentally won five million lottery tickets. After deducting taxes, you got a lot of money, and everyone around you was staring at how you planned to spend it. Do you want to give generously to the society, or leave it to your family and have your own calculations? It's about perceptions of wealth and trade-offs.

scene: 公司年底有了可观利润，董事会和员工代表在吵：是给股东分红、还是先给全员普涨工资？也有人提员工持股或留作发展基金。这是利润归谁、怎么分的根本问题。

options.t: 利润该先给基层普涨工资，干活的人最该先分享成果，而不是都流去分红。
options.t_en: Profits should first be increased to the grassroots, and those who work should first share the results, rather than flowing to dividends.

options.t: 按股份分红才合理，谁投了资、承担了风险，谁就该拿回报。
options.t_en: It is only reasonable to distribute dividends according to shares. Whoever invests and assumes risks should get a return.

options.t: 设个员工持股计划，让大伙都当「小股东」，利润共享、干劲也足。
options.t_en: Set up an employee shareholding plan, so that everyone can become a "small shareholder", profit sharing, and motivation.

options.t: 留作发展基金，用来扩产研发，公司做强了大家长远才更好。
options.t_en: It is reserved as a development fund to expand production and research and development, and it is better for the company to strengthen everyone in the long run.

options.t: 高管少拿点、把钱多拨给基层员工，顶层已经拿够了，该往下倾斜。
options.t_en: Executives take less and allocate more money to grassroots employees. The top floor has enough and should be tilted downward.

scene_en: The company had a considerable profit at the end of the year, and the board and employee representatives were arguing: Is it a dividend for shareholders, or a general salary increase for all employees first? Employees also hold shares or are set aside as development funds. This is the fundamental question of who and how to divide the profits.

scene: 关于是否开征、怎么开征遗产税，学界和公众吵得凶。支持者说能促进代际公平，反对者说财产既然是私人合法所得就不应再被征一遍。这是公平与产权之间的张力。

options.t: 应该征较高的遗产税，把代际积累的差距拉平，让出身不那么决定命运。
options.t_en: Higher inheritance taxes should be levied to level the gap accumulated between generations and make origin less destiny-determining.

options.t: 财产是私人合法所有，辛苦挣的传给子女不该再被征一道税。
options.t_en: Property is privately and legally owned, and hard-earned passes to children should not be taxed again.

options.t: 小额遗产免税、超出大额部分才征，既保普通人家、也调超高财富。
options.t_en: Small inheritance is exempt from taxation, and only the large amount is levied, which not only insures ordinary people, but also promotes super-high wealth.

options.t: 完全取消遗产税，尊重个人处置自己财产的全部权利。
options.t_en: Completely abolish the estate tax and respect the individual's full right to dispose of their property.

scene_en: Regarding whether and how to levy an inheritance tax, the academic community and the public are fiercely arguing. Proponents say it promotes intergenerational equity, while opponents say property should not be requisitioned again since it is a legitimate private gain. This is the tension between equity and property rights.

scene: 失业救济金该发多久，政策讨论中两派对立：一派主张长保到再就业，一派主张短促人尽快找工作。这关乎安全网该织多厚。

options.t: 救济应该长期保障，一直发到他重新就业为止，不能让人断了生计。
options.t_en: Relief should be provided in the long term, until he is re-employed, and livelihoods should not be cut off.

options.t: 救济宜短，给一阵缓冲就好，太长反而让人不想找工作、养懒汉。
options.t_en: Relief should be short, just give a buffer for a while, it is too long but people don't want to look for work and raise lazy people.

options.t: 按你之前缴费年限来定能领多久，缴得多领得久，公平又讲贡献。
options.t_en: Determine how long you can receive according to the number of years you have paid before, pay more, and contribute fairly.

scene_en: How long should unemployment benefits be paid? In the policy discussion, two parties are at odds: one advocates long-term protection until re-employment, and the other advocates short-term people looking for work as soon as possible. It's about how thick the safety net should be woven.

scene: 某地公共福利资源紧张，有人提议福利该跟户籍或本地缴纳挂钩，也有人主张全民普惠、不论来源。这关乎「谁有资格享受公共品」。

options.t: 公共服务应当全民普惠，只要在这片土地上生活就该同等享受，不该分三六九等。
options.t_en: Public services should be universal, and as long as they live on this land, they should be equally enjoyed, not divided into 369 grades.

options.t: 我倾向先保障本地缴纳社保的人，资源有限，先顾为这个地方出过力的住户。
options.t_en: I tend to protect local social security contributors first, with limited resources, and first look out for households who have worked hard for this place.

scene_en: In a place where public welfare resources are tight, some people propose that benefits should be linked to household registration or local payment. Others advocate universal benefits, regardless of source. It's about “who qualifies for public goods”.

scene: 一笔产业补贴该怎么发，决策层犯难：是扶那些吸纳就业多的小商户，还是补给效率高的大企业？也有人主张按受困程度或公开竞标。这是效率与公平、救急与淘汰的权衡。

options.t: 钱该扶小商户，它们吸纳的就业最多，保住它们就是保住普通人的饭碗。
options.t_en: Money should support small businesses. They absorb the most jobs. To keep them is to keep ordinary people's jobs.

options.t: 补给大企业效率最高，它们体量大、拉动强，有限的钱花在刀刃上。
options.t_en: The supply of large enterprises is the most efficient, they are large and powerful, and limited money is spent on the blade.

options.t: 按谁更受困来分，哪家真的快撑不住就先救哪家，不看出身看难处。
options.t_en: According to who is more trapped, which family really can't hold out and which one to save first, don't see the difficulty.

options.t: 少搞直接补贴，多减税降费，让市场自己决定谁活谁死更干净。
options.t_en: Reduce direct subsidies, reduce taxes and fees, and let the market decide who lives and dies cleaner.

options.t: 公开竞标分配补贴，谁的方案好、性价比高就给谁，透明不偏袒。
options.t_en: Open bidding for the allocation of subsidies, whose plan is good and cost-effective will be given to whoever, transparency and non-selectivity.

options.t: 不补贴，让市场自然淘汰，该倒的的倒，资源才能重新配置。
options.t_en: No subsidies, let the market naturally eliminate, the pour should be poured, the resources can be reallocated.

scene_en: How should an industrial subsidy be issued, and the decision makers are in trouble: are they supporting small businesses that absorb more employment, or large enterprises with high supply efficiency? There are also advocates for bidding based on the degree of distress or openness. This is a trade-off between efficiency and equity, first aid and obsolescence.

scene: 大家聊起为什么贫富差距越拉越大，有人归咎制度、有人归咎个人努力、有人提教育和全球化。怎么归因，决定了该开什么药方。这是关于不平等根源的价值观分歧。

options.t: 是制度还不够均，分配机制该往更平等的方向改，光靠个人努力补不上结构漏洞。
options.t_en: It is that the system is not yet even, and the distribution mechanism should be changed in a more equal direction, and individual efforts alone cannot make up for structural loopholes.

options.t: 说到底是个人的努力和选择不同，有人拼有人躺，差距自然就来了。
options.t_en: After all, personal efforts and choices are different. If someone is lying down, the gap will naturally come.

options.t: 根子在教育和机会不均，出身决定了起跑线，这才是差距的真正来源。
options.t_en: Roots are unequal in education and opportunity, and origin determines the starting line, which is the real source of the gap.

options.t: 这是全球化带来的，资本和产业链流动放大了群与群的落差。
options.t_en: This is brought about by globalization, and the flow of capital and industrial chains amplifies the gap between the group and the group.

scene_en: People talk about why the gap between the rich and the poor is widening, some people blame the system, some people blame personal efforts, some people mention education and globalization. How it is attributed determines what prescription should be prescribed. This is a divergence of values about the root causes of inequality.

scene: 每年公共预算就那么多，议会和民众在争优先投哪：是民生福利、基建增长，还是先还债求稳健？钱往哪花，体现的是治理的重心。

options.t: 优先民生福利，养老、医疗、低保这些直接关系普通人冷暖，该排第一。
options.t_en: Prioritize people's livelihood welfare, elderly care, medical care, and low security, which are directly related to the cooling and warming of ordinary people, ranking first.

options.t: 优先基建和增长，把路、网、产业搞起来，盘子做大了福利才有源头。
options.t_en: Prioritize infrastructure and growth, build roads, grids, and industries, and only when the plate is bigger can the welfare have a source.

options.t: 先还债、求财政稳健，别寅吃卯粮，账本健康比花出去更重要。
options.t_en: Repay the debt first, seek financial stability, don't eat dirty food, the health of the ledger is more important than spending.

scene_en: With so many public budgets each year, parliament and the public are competing over which to prioritize: people's livelihoods, infrastructure growth, or debt repayment first for soundness? Where the money goes, it reflects the center of gravity of governance.

scene: 本地一家老牌工厂被外来低价货挤垮、订单锐减面临关门，上千工人可能失业。有人主张保护、有人主张让它死。这是产业保护与优胜劣汰的拉锯。

options.t: 政府该设关税挡一挡，给本地产业喘息空间，不能眼睁睁看工人失业。
options.t_en: The government should set tariffs as a barrier to give the local industry room to breathe, and can't wait to see workers unemployed.

options.t: 放开竞争、逼它升级，保护只会养懒，挨打说明产品得改造。
options.t_en: Let go of competition, force it to upgrade, protection will only lazy, be beaten to show that the product has to be transformed.

options.t: 给补贴助它转型而不是保护落后，扶上马送一程、让它自己硬起来。
options.t_en: Subsidies subsidize its transformation rather than protect it from backwardness, help it up and give it a ride, and let it harden itself.

options.t: 让它倒闭、资源重组，市场淘汰低效产能，长痛不如短痛。
options.t_en: Let it go out of business, reorganize resources, and eliminate inefficient production capacity in the market. Long-term pain is not as good as short-term pain.

scene_en: Thousands of workers could lose their jobs as an old local factory is squeezed by cheap imports and orders dwindle to the brink of closure. Some advocate protection, some advocate letting it die. This is a pulling saw for industrial protection and survival of the fittest.

scene: 采购和招商时，要不要给本土小品牌倾斜？支持者说要扶本土、反对者说该质量优先不论出处。这关乎本土偏好与开放竞争。

options.t: 应优先采购本土品牌，肥水不流外人田，先顾自家的产业和就业。
options.t_en: Priority should be given to purchasing local brands, fertilizer and water will not flow to foreigners, and their own industries and employment should be considered first.

options.t: 质量优先、不论产地，谁的东西好就用谁的，地方保护只会惯坏企业。
options.t_en: Quality first, regardless of the origin, whose goods are good will be used by whoever, and local protection will only habitually be bad for the enterprise.

options.t: 给本土小品牌减税扶持，降低它们的起跑门槛，但不强买强卖。
options.t_en: Give small local brands tax cuts and support to lower their starting thresholds, but do not force them to buy and sell.

scene_en: When purchasing and attracting investment, should we give preference to small local brands? Supporters said to support the local, opponents said that the quality priority regardless of the source. It's about local preferences and open competition.

scene: 你所在的企业打算把工厂迁到成本更低的地区，本地员工面临失业、地方税收也要缩水。企业说要优化布局，员工和地方则不愿它走。这是资本自由与本地责任的冲突。

options.t: 企业该留在本地为工人保住岗位，不能只为省钱就抛弃在这扎根的员工。
options.t_en: Enterprises should stay local to save jobs for workers, not just to save money and abandon employees who are rooted here.

options.t: 企业有权选成本最优的厂址，这是正常的经营优化，拦着才不合理。
options.t_en: Enterprises have the right to choose the factory site with the best cost. This is normal business optimization, and it is unreasonable to stop it.

scene_en: Your business plans to move factories to lower-cost areas, with local workers facing job losses and shrinking local taxes. Companies say to optimize the layout, employees and places do not want it to go. This is a conflict between capital freedom and local responsibility.

scene: 某个行业里跑出一家独大的公司，市占率超过七成，小玩家几乎活不下去，消费者和监管都开始担心它滥用地位。怎么对待这个巨头，各方思路不同。这是垄断与竞争的老问题。

options.t: 政府该出手拆分、反垄断，一家独大早晚会滥用市场力量，得早早管住。
options.t_en: The government should take action to break up and antitrust, and a family will abuse market power in the morning and evening, and have to control it early.

options.t: 让市场自然竞争，巨头若服务差、价格高，消费者自会用脚投票。
options.t_en: Let the market compete naturally. If giants have poor services and high prices, consumers will vote with their feet.

options.t: 不强拆但加强监管，防它滥用支配地位、搞二选一那套。
options.t_en: Do not forcibly dismantle but strengthen supervision to prevent it from abusing its dominant position and engaging in the alternative.

options.t: 消费者用脚投票，不爽就别用它的产品，市场自有制约。
options.t_en: Consumers vote with their feet. If they are unhappy, don't use its products. The market has its own restrictions.

options.t: 直接国有化，关键行业不该被私人巨头把控。
options.t_en: Direct nationalization, key industries should not be controlled by private giants.

scene_en: An industry has emerged as a monopoly company with a market share of more than 70%. Small players can hardly survive, and consumers and regulators have begun to worry about its abuse of position. Different parties have different ideas on how to treat this giant. It's an old question of monopoly and competition.

scene: 工厂引入机器人产线，效率翻倍但一批工人被顶替、面临下岗。社会在争：该向机器征税补贴人，还是让人再培训适应？这关乎技术进步与就业保障。

options.t: 应向部署机器人的企业征「机器人税」，用这笔钱补贴被替代的失业工人。
options.t_en: A “robot tax” should be levied on companies deploying robots to subsidize displaced workers.

options.t: 技术进步必然、挡不住，重点是把下岗工人再培训、转岗，而不是拦技术。
options.t_en: Technological progress is inevitable and unstoppable, and the focus is on retraining and transferring laid-off workers, rather than blocking technology.

options.t: 限制自动化的速度、保住岗位，不该为了效率让普通人轻易失去饭碗。
options.t_en: Limiting the speed of automation and preserving jobs should not make it easy for ordinary people to lose their jobs in order to be efficient.

options.t: 我接受自动化，但主张同步缩短工时，让技术红利变成大家少干活、多休息。
options.t_en: I accept automation, but advocate shortening working hours synchronously, so that the technology dividend becomes less work and more rest for everyone.

scene_en: The factory introduced a robot production line, doubling its efficiency, but a group of workers were replaced and faced layoffs. Society is competing: should machines be taxed to subsidize people, or should people be retrained to adapt? It's about technological progress and job security.

scene: 海外农产品比本地便宜三成，超市里消费者用脚投票买进口的，本地农民叫苦、呼吁限制进口。这是消费者实惠与农民生计的冲突。

options.t: 应该保护农民、限制进口，不然本地农业垮了、饭碗攥在别人手里。
options.t_en: Farmers should be protected and imports restricted, otherwise local agriculture will collapse and jobs will be held by others.

options.t: 消费者得了实惠就该开放，谁便宜买谁，贸易自由对老百姓最划算。
options.t_en: Consumers should be open when they get affordable, who buys cheaply, and trade freedom is the most cost-effective for the people.

options.t: 保住战略性的基本自给，其余的放开进口，安全和实惠两头兼顾。
options.t_en: Maintain strategic basic self-sufficiency, and liberalize the rest of the imports for both safety and affordability.

scene_en: Overseas agricultural products are 30% cheaper than local ones. If consumers in supermarkets use their feet to vote for imports, local farmers cry for hardship and call for restrictions on imports. This is a conflict between consumer affordability and farmers' livelihoods.

scene: 在关键行业和民生领域，国有还是民营为主导，向来争论不休。有人要国有把控、有人要全面民营、也有人主张混合。这是所有制选择的根本分歧。

options.t: 关键领域必须国有，涉及命脉和公共利益的得握在国家手里才稳。
options.t_en: Key areas must be state-owned, and those involving lifelines and public interests must be in the hands of the state.

options.t: 全面民营最高效，竞争出活力，国企能做的民营也能做、还更灵活。
options.t_en: Comprehensive private enterprises are the most efficient and competitive, and private enterprises that can be done by state-owned enterprises can also do it and be more flexible.

options.t: 混合所有制最好，国资民资各取所长，不非此即彼。
options.t_en: Mixed ownership is the best, and the state-owned and privately-owned assets have their own strengths, which are either one or the other.

options.t: 竞争中立，不管国有民营用同一套规则比，谁行谁上。
options.t_en: Competition is neutral, regardless of who uses the same set of rules as the state-owned private sector.

options.t: 战略领域国有、一般民生民营，分而治之。
options.t_en: In the strategic field, state-owned and ordinary people's livelihood and private enterprises are divided and governed.

options.t: 看效率定，哪样效率高就选哪样，不先验站队。
options.t_en: See if the efficiency is fixed, choose the one that is as efficient as possible, and do not stand in the team a priori.

scene_en: In key industries and areas of people's livelihood, whether state-owned or private-owned is dominant and has always been debated. Some people want state control, some people want full private ownership, and some people advocate mixing. This is a fundamental divergence in the choice of ownership.

scene: 某外卖或网约车平台把抽成提到近三成，司机和商户抱怨赚的还不够平台拿的，呼吁管一管。是立法限价还是交给市场，争论起。

options.t: 应当立法限制平台抽成比例，不能让它凭垄断地位随意榨取。
options.t_en: Legislation should be enacted to restrict the platform from drawing proportionally and not allowing it to be squeezed arbitrarily based on its monopoly position.

options.t: 这是平台和市场博弈的事，让双方自己谈、自治就好，政府别伸手。
options.t_en: This is a game between the platform and the market. Just let the two sides talk and autonomy, and don't reach out to the government.

scene_en: A certain takeaway or online ride-hailing platform mentioned nearly 30%. Drivers and merchants complained that the platform did not make enough money to take it, and called for management. Whether to legislate a price limit or leave it to the market is debated.

scene: 一批消费者买了某品牌问题产品，维权群里几百人，有人想集体告、有人想等监管、也有人自认倒霉。怎么维权各有路数。这关乎个体维权与集体行动。

options.t: 我牵头组织集体诉讼，大家抱团维权，单个消费者根本拼不过大公司。
options.t_en: I took the lead in organizing a class-action lawsuit, and everyone held a group to defend their rights. Individual consumers could not compete with large companies.

options.t: 我主张监管重罚，让执法部门出手整治这种坑消费者的行为。
options.t_en: I advocate regulating heavy penalties and letting law enforcement deal with the behavior of such pit consumers.

options.t: 我自认倒霉，下次不买这个牌子就是，懒得为维权耗时间精力。
options.t_en: I consider myself unlucky. The next time I don't buy this brand, I won't bother to spend time and energy defending rights.

options.t: 我建个黑名单把问题商家公示出来，提醒别人别踩坑，也算一种维权。
options.t_en: I made a blacklist to publicize the business in question, reminding others not to step in the pit, which is also a kind of protection of rights.

scene_en: A group of consumers bought a brand problem product, and there were hundreds of people in the rights protection group. Some people wanted to collectively sue, some wanted to wait for supervision, and some people thought that they were unlucky. How to defend rights has its own number of ways. It's about individual activism and collective action.

scene: 不少制造企业把产线往海外低成本地区搬，国内相关产业链出现空洞化担忧。有人主张守住自主、有人主张融入全球。这是产业安全与效率的全球权衡。

options.t: 要保住产业链自主可控，关键环节不能全出去，否则被人卡脖子。
options.t_en: To ensure that the industrial chain is autonomous and controllable, the key links cannot all go out, otherwise they will be stuck in the neck.

options.t: 融入全球分工就好，哪成本低去哪，效率最大化对各方都好。
options.t_en: It is good for all parties to integrate into the global division of labor, where the cost is low and the efficiency is maximized.

options.t: 关键环节自主、其余外包，安全和效率各取一半。
options.t_en: The key links are autonomous, the rest are outsourced, and the safety and efficiency are halved.

scene_en: Many manufacturing enterprises have moved production lines to low-cost areas overseas, and there are concerns about the hollowing out of relevant domestic industrial chains. Some advocate autonomy, some advocate integration into the world. This is a global trade-off between industrial safety and efficiency.

scene: 市政规划在你们小区旁建一座垃圾处理厂，说技术达标、对居民无害，但住户们还是担心异味、房价和健康的「别建我家旁」。这典型是邻避困境。

options.t: 我反对建在我家旁边，再怎么达标我也不想天天闻着、住得提心吊胆。
options.t_en: I am opposed to building next to my home, and I don't want to smell and live with fear every day.

options.t: 这类设施城市确实需要，该建，但得给周边住户合理补偿、做好防护。
options.t_en: Such facilities are really needed and should be built, but the surrounding residents must be reasonably compensated and protected.

options.t: 我支持并愿意就近——只要真达标，必要的市政设施我来分担没什么。
options.t_en: I am supportive and willing to be nearby - as long as the standards are met, I will share the necessary municipal facilities.

options.t: 我自己是邻避、不想建旁边，但同时支持在别处建，总得有人扛。
options.t_en: I am a neighbor and do not want to build a side, but at the same time support building elsewhere, someone must carry it.

scene_en: The city plans to build a garbage disposal plant next to your neighborhood, saying that the technology is up to standard and harmless to residents, but residents are still worried about odors, house prices and health "don't build next to my house". This is typically a neighborly dilemma.

scene: 关于限塑，政策在「禁、收费、还是随便用」之间摇摆。环保派要禁，商家和消费者觉得收费或自由更现实。这是环保约束与生活便利的拉锯。

options.t: 应该直接禁塑，从源头断掉一次性塑料袋，环保才治本。
options.t_en: Plastic should be banned directly, and disposable plastic bags should be broken from the source, so as to cure the root cause of environmental protection.

options.t: 收费就行，用经济杠杆让人少拿，比一禁了之更柔和、可执行。
options.t_en: Just charge, and use economic leverage to make people take less, which is softer and more enforceable than the one forbidden.

options.t: 自由选用，成年人自己决定要不要袋子，别用规定替人做主。
options.t_en: Use it freely. Adults decide whether they want bags or not. Don't use regulations to make decisions for others.

scene_en: Regarding plastic restrictions, the policy swings between "prohibited, charged, or casual". Environmentalists want to ban it, and merchants and consumers feel that charging or freedom is more realistic. This is a tug saw for environmental constraints and convenience of life.

scene: 一群野生动物下山钻进农田啃庄稼，农户一年的指望眼看被糟蹋，保护站却说这是珍稀物种不能伤。保收成还是保动物，农户两难。这关乎人与自然的直接冲突。

options.t: 把它们驱离、但不伤害，赶回山上就好，人和动物各退一步。
options.t_en: Drive them away, but don't hurt them, just hurry back to the mountain, people and animals retreat one step at a time.

options.t: 必要时可以捕杀，庄稼是农户的命根子，保收成优先于保这些动物。
options.t_en: If necessary, they can be killed. Crops are the lifeblood of farmers, and the protection of the harvest takes precedence over the protection of these animals.

scene_en: A group of wild animals descended the hill and drilled into the farmland to gnaw crops. The farmers' expectations for a year were ruined, but the protection station said that this was a rare species that could not be hurt. Whether to secure the harvest or the animals, farmers face a dilemma. It is about the direct conflict between man and nature.

scene: 城建要新修一条路缓解拥堵，规划线恰好要砍掉一棵上了年头的大树，爱树的人和盼路通的人吵起来。这关乎绿化和出行便利的取舍。

options.t: 保树，路可以改线绕开，一棵老树长起来不容易，比一条捷径珍贵。
options.t_en: Baoshu, the road can be changed and bypassed, an old tree is not easy to grow, more precious than a shortcut.

options.t: 发展为重，该砍就砍，路通了大家通勤省时，整体收益更大。
options.t_en: The development is heavy, the cut should be cut, and the road will save everyone commuting time, and the overall benefits will be greater.

options.t: 能移栽就移栽，把树挪到别处活下来，既保树又不耽误修路。
options.t_en: If you can transplant it, transplant it, and move the tree to another place to survive, both protecting the tree and not delaying road construction.

options.t: 先做生态评估再定，看这树是不是珍稀、砍了影响多大，别拍脑袋。
options.t_en: Do an ecological assessment before deciding whether this tree is rare and how much impact it has had. Don't shoot your head.

options.t: 开公众听证，让受影响的居民和专家一起谈，谁去谁留听大家的。
options.t_en: Hold a public hearing, and let the affected residents and experts talk about who goes and who listens to everyone.

scene_en: Urban construction wants to build a new road to relieve congestion. The planning line is about to cut down a big tree that has been on for years, and people who love trees and people who want to pass through the road quarrel. This is about the trade-off between greening and ease of getting around.

scene: 一家工厂被查实偷排污水，下游村庄的水质受影响、村民意见大，处罚轻重成了焦点。怎么罚、赔不赔、关不关，各有主张。这是环境违法的问责尺度。

options.t: 重罚并限期整改，排污就得付出足够代价，不然下次还敢。
options.t_en: Heavy fines and rectification within a time limit will have to pay a sufficient price for sewage discharge, or you will dare to do it again next time.

options.t: 罚一笔款了事，走完程序就行，别把企业一棍子打死。
options.t_en: After fining a sum of money, just go through the procedure and don't beat the enterprise to death.

options.t: 按市场价赔给受影响的村民，污染损失该用真金白银补偿。
options.t_en: Compensate the affected villagers according to the market price, and compensate for the pollution loss with real gold and silver.

options.t: 直接关停，屡教不改或危害大的就该让它关门。
options.t_en: Just shut it down, and if it is not changed or harmful, let it close the door.

scene_en: A factory was verified to be sewage. The water quality of the downstream villages was affected, and the opinions of the villagers were large, and the severity of the punishment became the focus. How to punish, whether to compensate or not, whether to pass or not, each has their own opinions. This is the measure of accountability for environmental violations.

scene: 气候议题热，关于「普通人该为减碳负多少责」争论起：是从我做起，还是主要靠政策和企业。这关乎个人行动与系统责任。

options.t: 我从自己做起，少开车、节约用电，个人习惯的累加也是力量。
options.t_en: I started from myself, driving less, saving electricity, and accumulating personal habits are also strength.

options.t: 主要靠政策和企业减排，个人那点碳排放杯水车薪，大头该由它们扛。
options.t_en: Mainly relying on policies and companies to reduce emissions, individuals' carbon emission cups and wages should be borne by them.

options.t: 个人随便，减碳是系统的事，别把责任都摊到普通人日常头上。
options.t_en: Individuals can do whatever they want. Carbon reduction is a systematic matter. Don't put the responsibility on ordinary people's daily lives.

scene_en: The climate issue is hot, and the debate about "how much responsibility should ordinary people take for carbon reduction" starts with me, or mainly depends on policies and companies. It's about individual action and systemic responsibility.

scene: 一处生态保护区想开发旅游创收，支持适度开放、反对全封、也有人要商业大开发或社区分红。怎么在保护和收益间拿捏，争论不休。这关乎生态与生计。

options.t: 适度开放、用门票收入反哺保护，既创收又不伤生态，平衡最好。
options.t_en: It is moderately open and protected with ticket income, which neither generates income nor harms the ecology, and the balance is the best.

options.t: 核心区全封、谁都不进，保护优先，开发的事另说。
options.t_en: The core area is fully enclosed, no one enters, protection is a priority, and development is another matter.

options.t: 让周边社区参与分红，保护带来的收益反哺原著居民，他们才愿意护。
options.t_en: Let the surrounding communities participate in dividends, and the benefits of protection will nourish the original inhabitants, who are willing to protect.

options.t: 商业大开发，建酒店游乐，把生态资源彻底变现。
options.t_en: Great commercial development, building hotels for recreation, and completely monetizing ecological resources.

options.t: 限流预约，控制人数进核心区，既让人看又不压垮环境。
options.t_en: The current limitation reservation controls the number of people entering the core area, which is both visible and not overwhelming to the environment.

options.t: 不开发、保持原样，留给自然本身。
options.t_en: Do not develop, keep as is, leave to nature itself.

scene_en: An ecological reserve wants to develop tourism to generate income, supports moderate opening, opposes full enclosure, and some people want commercial development or community dividends. How to choose between protection and profit is debated. It's about ecology and livelihoods.

scene: 一种外来物种在本地水域疯长、挤占本土物种生存空间，要不要全力清除成焦点。有人要斩草除根、有人觉得顺其自然。这是生态干预的尺度。

options.t: 全力清除，外来物种失控会毁掉本地生态，越早下手越好。
options.t_en: If all efforts are made to clear it, out-of-control alien species will destroy the local ecology, and the sooner you do this, the better.

options.t: 顺其自然，生态系统自己会找到平衡，人为清除也可能带来别的乱子。
options.t_en: If left to itself, ecosystems will find their own balance, and human-cleansing can lead to other disruptions.

scene_en: An exotic species grows wildly in the local waters, squeezing the living space of the native species, and whether to remove it into focus. Some people want to cut grass and root, some people feel that it is natural. This is the scale of ecological intervention.

scene: 制定环保排放标准时，定高还是定低让企业叫苦、环保组织喊低，各方拉锯。这是倒逼转型与顾及承受的权衡。

options.t: 标准从严，用硬约束倒逼企业转型、上环保技术。
options.t_en: The standards are strict, and hard constraints are used to force enterprises to transform and adopt environmentally friendly technologies.

options.t: 得顾及企业承受力，标准太高一批厂子直接垮，就业也跟着完。
options.t_en: We have to take into account the affordability of enterprises. A number of factories with too high standards have collapsed directly, and employment has ended.

options.t: 分阶段逐步提标，给企业缓冲期慢慢改，既严又不至于一下压死。
options.t_en: Gradually raise the bid in stages, and slowly change the buffer period for the enterprise, which is not strict and will not lead to a crushing death.

options.t: 跟国际标准接轨，别自己定一套低的，全球同标才说得过去。
options.t_en: In line with international standards, don't set yourself a set of low standards, the global standard can only be said to be valid.

scene_en: When setting environmental protection emission standards, setting high or setting low makes enterprises cry bitter, environmental protection organizations cry low, and all parties pull the saw. This is a trade-off between forceful transformation and consideration for endurance.

scene: 小区一块空地，物业提议要么做成绿地花园、要么改停车位缓解停车难，居民意见分裂。这是环境美观与日常便利的取舍。

options.t: 留作绿地，小区多点绿、孩子有地方跑，比多几个车位值。
options.t_en: Leave it as a green space, the neighborhood is more green, and the children have a place to run, which is a few more than the parking space value.

options.t: 改成车位更便民，回去晚了绕半天找不着位，停车痛点更现实。
options.t_en: It was more convenient to change to a parking space. After returning late, I couldn't find a place for half a day, and the pain points of parking were more realistic.

options.t: 地下做停车场、地上留绿地，两样都要，空间往下借。
options.t_en: Do parking underground and leave green space on the ground, both of which are required, and borrow the space downwards.

scene_en: The community is a vacant lot, and the property proposes to either make a green garden or change the parking space to alleviate the difficulty of parking, and the opinions of the residents are divided. This is a trade-off between the beauty of the environment and the convenience of everyday life.

scene: 学校打算统一校服，支持者说整齐平等、反对者说压抑个性，也有人提自愿或免收。这是集体规范与个人表达的拉扯。

options.t: 应该穿校服，大家一样、不比穿戴、还显整齐，平等感重要。
options.t_en: School uniforms should be worn, everyone is the same, no more than wearing, but also neat, the sense of equality is important.

options.t: 不该统一，校服把孩子的个性都压没了，穿着自由也是自我表达。
options.t_en: They should not be unified. School uniforms depress the child's personality. Wearing freedom is also self-expression.

options.t: 自愿穿，想穿的穿、不想的不强求，不拿规定绑着。
options.t_en: Voluntarily wear, want to wear, do not want to force, do not take regulations tied.

options.t: 家庭困难的免收校服费，别让穷孩子因为买不起而被落下。
options.t_en: Waive school uniform fees for families with difficulties, and don't let poor children be left behind because they can't afford it.

scene_en: The school intends to unify the uniform, with supporters saying that it is neat and equal, opponents saying that it suppresses personality, and some people volunteer or exempt. This is a tug of war between collective norms and individual expression.

scene: 学校以运营成本上升为由拟上调学费，家长和学生叫苦，有人要控价、有人认市场。这是教育可及性与办学质量的权衡。

options.t: 应该控价保公平，教育是公共品，涨太多普通家庭扛不住。
options.t_en: Prices should be controlled and protected fairly, education is a public good, and too many ordinary families can't bear it.

options.t: 市场定价、提质就好，收高点服务上去，愿意买单的得益。
options.t_en: Pricing and quality improvement in the market are good, the service will be higher, and you are willing to pay for the benefits.

options.t: 用奖学金把困难学生覆盖住，涨跌都别让穷孩子失学。
options.t_en: Covering difficult students with scholarships, do not let poor children drop out of school.

scene_en: The school plans to raise tuition fees because of rising operating costs. Parents and students are crying out for hardship. Some people want to control prices and some people recognize the market. This is a trade-off between educational accessibility and school quality.

scene: 关于老师能不能适度体罚违纪学生，家校两派吵得凶。支持者要立规矩、反对者说伤身心。这是管教与权益的边界。

options.t: 严禁体罚，无论什么理由都不能动手打学生，身心健康底线不能破。
options.t_en: Corporal punishment is strictly prohibited, students cannot be beaten for any reason, and the bottom line of physical and mental health cannot be broken.

options.t: 适度惩戒有必要，太温吞管不住违纪的，一点威严还是得有。
options.t_en: Moderate discipline is necessary. If you are too warm to control the discipline, you still need to have a little majesty.

scene_en: Regarding whether the teacher can moderately physically punish students who violate discipline, the two parties at home and school are fiercely arguing. Proponents behave and opponents say they are hurt. This is the boundary between discipline and rights.

scene: 课堂全面推行平板电脑教学成趋势，有人赞数字化、有人怕沉迷、也有人守书本。这是技术进课堂的尺度。

options.t: 全面数字化，平板效率高、资源丰富，教学该跟上时代。
options.t_en: Comprehensive digitalization, tablet efficiency, rich resources, teaching should keep up with the times.

options.t: 适度用、防沉迷，技术是好但不能让孩子陷进屏幕里。
options.t_en: Moderate use, anti-indulgence, technology is good but can not let children fall into the screen.

options.t: 传统书本为主，纸上学习更专注，平板少用为妙。
options.t_en: Traditional books are the mainstay, paper learning is more focused, and tablets are better if they are used less.

options.t: 按家庭条件配设备，不能让买不起的孩子掉队，资源得均衡。
options.t_en: Equipped with equipment according to family conditions, children who can't afford it should not be left behind, and resources should be balanced.

options.t: 教师自己定怎么用，懂学生的人最有发言权，别统一硬推。
options.t_en: The teacher decides how to use it. Those who understand the students have the most say. Don't push unanimously.

scene_en: The classroom has fully implemented the trend of tablet teaching. Some people praise digitalization, some people are afraid of indulgence, and some people keep books. This is the measure of technology entering the classroom.

scene: 升学评价长期「唯分数」，有人要多元评价、有人坚持分数最公平。这是评价标准之争。

options.t: 应多元评价，分数之外看特长、实践，孩子不是考试机器。
options.t_en: It should be evaluated in a variety of ways. In addition to scores, it should look at specialties and practices. Children are not examination machines.

options.t: 分数最公平，硬指标面前人人平等，主观评价才容易猫腻。
options.t_en: The score is the fairest, everyone is equal in front of hard indicators, and subjective evaluation is easy to get tired of.

options.t: 加素质分，在分数基础上兼顾其他表现，折中一下。
options.t_en: Add a quality score to take into account other performances on the basis of the score, and make a compromise.

options.t: 考试加面试，既看成绩也看综合，多维一把关。
options.t_en: Examination plus interview, both look at the results and look at the comprehensive, multi-dimensional a check.

scene_en: For long-term "score-only" evaluation, some people want diversified evaluation, and some people insist that the score is the fairest. This is a dispute over the evaluation criteria.

scene: 学校要不要推行双语教学引发讨论，支持者拓视野、反对者保母语。这是语言教育的取向。

options.t: 应推行双语，早点接触第二语言、拓孩子的国际视野。
options.t_en: Bilingualism should be promoted, and children should be exposed to second languages early to broaden their international horizons.

options.t: 母语为主，先把本国语言学扎实，根基比花哨重要。
options.t_en: The mother tongue is the main language, first of all, the linguistics of the country is solid, and the foundation is more important than the fancy.

options.t: 按地区选，多语种地区多推、单一地区少搞，因地制宜。
options.t_en: According to regional selection, multilingual areas push more, single areas do less, according to local conditions.

scene_en: Whether the school should promote bilingual teaching will trigger discussion, and supporters will broaden their horizons, while opponents will keep their mother tongue. This is the orientation of language education.

scene: 性教育要不要进课堂、怎么进，家长和学校分歧大——有人要系统教、有人留给家长、有人反对。这是成长教育与保守观念的拉锯。

options.t: 应系统教，科学的性知识进课堂，孩子才不会被误导。
options.t_en: Should be taught systematically, scientific sexual knowledge into the classroom, so that children will not be misled.

options.t: 这种事家长教就行，学校别越俎代庖，家里讲更合适。
options.t_en: This kind of thing can be taught by parents, the school should not be more vigorous, and it is more appropriate to talk at home.

options.t: 设为选修，想学的来、不想的不强求，给选择空间。
options.t_en: Set it as an elective. If you want to learn and don't want to force, give it space to choose.

options.t: 校方统一必修，既然重要就该人人都学，不能看家长脸色。
